text:
¿Castigas in the eagle the delito

of the celos of Juno vengadora,

because in velocidad alta and sonorous

llevó a Jove robado the catamito?


¿or juzgaste his osar por infinito

in atrever his eyes a your aurora,

confiada in the vista vencedora,

with that miran al sun of hito in hito?


¿or because sepa Jove that in the sky,

when Venus fulminas, of your rayo

ni the suyo is seguro, ni his vuelo?


¿or a César amenazas with desmayo,

derramando his emblema por the suelo,

honrando the leones of Pelayo?

translation.title: ¿Castigas in the eagle the delito?
